provenance.source_tree_semantics: repository_head_examined is the locally available parent/base tree read for this design; it is not the later artifact commit
provenance.canonical_invariant: If reviewed_head_available_locally is false and relationship_to_reviewed_sha is UNKNOWN, repository_head_examined MUST NOT equal reviewed_head_supplied absent separately recorded materialization/content-equivalence evidence.

identity_separation.entity_identity: account_id answers which account this is
identity_separation.operation_idempotency: answers whether this is a retry of the same logical genesis operation
identity_separation.business_subject_uniqueness: answers whether an external subject may own another account

entity_uniqueness.invariant: one genuine account_id -> at most one immutable account genesis
entity_uniqueness.enforcement: unique durable genesis key plus per-account_id serialization/CAS; no LWW

idempotency_candidates.caller_controllability: caller selection of genuine ID FORBIDDEN; allocation owner NOT_FROZEN
idempotency_candidates.reason: Could anchor retries only if authority durably re-resolves the same reservation; reservation is not genesis authority.

idempotency_candidates.caller_controllability: NO for accepted membership; exact decision ID absent
idempotency_candidates.uniqueness_scope: M0.3 device first-run membership, not account genesis
idempotency_candidates.durability: accepted membership exists, genesis linkage absent
idempotency_candidates.authentication: ProvisioningMembershipBinding accepted by external boundary; public SHA insufficient
idempotency_candidates.reason: No exact issuer-issued account-genesis decision ID exists.

idempotency_candidates.uniqueness_scope: one logical account-genesis operation within authority domain
idempotency_candidates.reason: Would meet the contract, but authority, issuance, schema and durable recovery do not exist.

idempotency_candidates.uniqueness_scope: root-proof decision, not necessarily one genesis operation
idempotency_candidates.reason: Root proof may be reused or mapped differently; cardinality and identity are not frozen.
Atomic protocol, participant ownership and decision identifier are absent.

idempotency_candidates.two_legitimate_account_creations_can_use: Only if business cardinality allowed; NOT_FROZEN
idempotency_candidates.reason: Conflates business uniqueness with operation idempotency; subject identity is absent.

idempotency_candidates.authority_owner: caller issues; authority only interprets in older design
idempotency_candidates.stability_across_retries: NO: caller may replace cmd_1 with cmd_2
idempotency_candidates.stability_across_crash_restart: Only for exact repeated ID if journal survives
idempotency_candidates.durability: authority retention proposed elsewhere but not a stable logical identity
idempotency_candidates.authentication: journal would require authentication; caller ID itself is not authority
idempotency_candidates.retry_returns_same_account: Only when caller reuses the key
idempotency_candidates.reason: A caller-generated random command ID alone cannot identify retries when the caller can replace it.
No canonical stable authority-issued identity binds every retry of one logical account-genesis operation.

provisioning_generation_revision.per_account: bound with account_id in claim/consumption but not proven unique per account

selected_or_blocked_idempotency_model.same_logical_account_genesis_operation: requires one stable, authenticated, durable authority-issued identity that survives caller retries and restart and is bound to one canonical semantic request; no such identity is currently owned
selected_or_blocked_idempotency_model.new_legal_account_genesis: a different authority-issued idempotency identity and different reserved account_id may be independent unless a future business uniqueness contract forbids it
selected_or_blocked_idempotency_model.decision_id_need: A distinct ID would aid audit, provenance, dedupe and recovery, but account_id already enforces entity uniqueness and no authority exists to issue the operation ID.

serialization_scope.per_reservation_identity: REQUIRED if a reservation protocol is selected
serialization_scope.per_idempotency_identity: REQUIRED if an idempotency identity is selected
serialization_scope.authority_global: FORBIDDEN as account singleton/deduplication mechanism; a total journal order is not required by this design
serialization_scope.per_external_subject: NOT_FROZEN / MUST NOT APPLY without cardinality contract
serialization_scope.cross_account_logical_operation_serializ: DESIGN_BLOCKED / depends on selected operation identity
serialization_scope.authority_journal_global_ordering: OPTIONAL / NOT_FORBIDDEN; may be selected for persistence, but cannot enforce that only one account exists
serialization_scope.global_singleton_serialization: FORBIDDEN as account-existence or deduplication rule

same_account_concurrency.same_account_same_idempotency_identity: one commit and one exact replay result
same_account_concurrency.same_account_different_idempotency_ident: at most one genesis; loser receives deterministic ALREADY_ADMITTED / CONFLICT / DENY, never a second genesis

distinct_account_concurrency.may_be_independent: CONDITIONAL: only after genuine authority-bound provenance establishes DISTINCT logical operations
distinct_account_concurrency.required_independence_proof: different authority-issued logical genesis identities, durable reservation identities, or issuer/root decisions under the future selected model

required_semantic_fields: exact provisioning decision reference if genesis consumes one
excluded_ephemeral_fields: transport correlation metadata unless semantically authoritative
request_binding.same_logical_operation_proof: must bind the same canonical semantic request

retry_semantics.same_identity_same_semantic_request: same committed result / exact replay; if prepared, recover the same operation
retry_semantics.same_identity_different_semantic_request: CONFLICT / CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT; no mutation and never a second account
retry_semantics.different_identities: not automatically conflict and not automatically independent; they may represent two legitimate creations only if authority-issued provenance establishes DISTINCT logical operations
retry_semantics.caller_changes_command_id_for_same_reque: does not create a trustworthy new logical identity or permission to silently remint

reservation_relationship.crash_retry: recover same durable reservation; never mint acct_B
reservation_relationship.genuine_account_id_at: only after genuine durable genesis commit
reservation_relationship.unproven_previous_reservation_absent_or_: FAIL_CLOSED rather than create a new independent reservation

crash_before_commit.recovery: recover the same authenticated idempotency/reservation state and either safely finish or fail closed
crash_before_commit.fallback_to_new_account_id: FORBIDDEN unless a genuine authenticated abort/release decision proves the previous logical operation is no longer live and a new operation is explicitly initiated

freshness.requirement: security-critical idempotency/reservation history requires an independent non-rollbackable freshness anchor

M03_interaction.bootstrap_generation_revision: FOUND but not globally/per-account unique and bound to device first-run claim
M03_interaction.claim_fingerprint_sha256: ephemeral claim identity / integrity fingerprint, not durable account-genesis identity
M03_interaction.reusable_identity_for_device_first_run: accepted claim fingerprint plus exact membership/consumption contract only

intrinsic_blockers: logical-operation identity selection and semantic binding are absent
reservation/idempotency durable state machine and crash protocol are absent
authentication key owner and freshness/rollback authority are absent
upstream_blockers: account ID mint/reservation owner and provisioning handoff remain NOT_FROZEN
external provisioning exposes no account-genesis decision identity

result.reason: Entity uniqueness is frozen on account_id, but current evidence supplies no stable authority-issued logical-genesis identity, authenticated durable recovery protocol, or freshness authority.

logical_operation_relationship.distinct_proof_requirement: Genuine authority-bound provenance must prove different authority-issued logical genesis identities, durable reservation identities, or issuer/root decisions under the future selected model.

critical_retry_split_scenario.outcome: recover acct_A reservation/operation or FAIL_CLOSED; acct_B requires an authenticated abort/release of O and explicitly initiated new operation
